The examined opening of The Verge’s Grand Theft Auto VI review praises its open-world detail and the relationship between its two protagonists. The reviewer describes a long playthrough and a deliberately paced opening before freer character switching.

This is a game review, not an audit of development methods. It entered the AI feed through Daring Fireball commentary contrasting the game’s launch with Anthropic’s offering. Neither that comparison nor the examined review establishes whether generative tools were used in production.
highlights: Freedom expands after a paced opening
Feed context supplied the AI connection
